notes: The teaching pictures move again. Every one of them was written to arrive a piece at a time, and not one of them did: the line that set that up wrote the animation as a shorthand with a variable inside it and then overrode part of it, which leaves the browser holding an animation with no name at all. Nothing errored. They simply appeared, instantly, which is the one thing this app is trying not to do, and it was happening in every picture in the course.
